projections.method: hand-built from 2025 season production, depth charts and preseason reporting
projections.note: Receptions are ESTIMATED from receiving yards at position-typical rates (WR 13.0, TE 11.0, RB 8.0 yards per catch). The set was originally built for a no-PPR league and never recorded them.
projections.caveat: These are season-long projections, not a live injury feed. A player who got hurt after this date still carries his healthy projection.
